report:
Behavior
- Treat one Recorder invocation as the sole transaction: admit into a private stage, spawn exactly once with inherited stdin, tee stdout/stderr separately and byte-for-byte (including large/binary data), scan/build the existing artifacts and manifest, remove raw capture, then publish one complete docket with create-if-absent semantics.
- A completed child signal outcome is archived first and then re-raised. Any Recorder infrastructure failure, including one concurrent with child nonzero/signal, wins with status 125, exactly one scanned JSON failure line after already-teed child stderr, and no apparently complete manifest/docket.
- Existing or child-created destinations, destination symlinks, and races are never overwritten or followed. Ordinary success/failure removes private transaction material; real cleanup and promotion failures remain Recorder failures.
- Installed `node_modules/.bin/ak-docket-record` from the packed tarball must prove inherited stdin, child nonzero, child signal, separate stream bytes, archived outcome fields, Recorder-failure precedence, and one-spawn behavior—not merely file presence or a happy-path invocation.

Owner
- `src/recorder/run.ts` owns transaction layout, cleanup ordering, and atomic create-if-absent publication. Keep `spawn.ts`, scanner/extraction, admission, manifest/schema, and all role/acceptance behavior unchanged unless a red test proves a defect at their existing seam.
- `bin/ak-docket-record.js` remains only the installed launcher and signal propagator; no second transaction path.
- Black-box test ownership stays in `test/recorder-transaction.test.ts` and `test/recorder-package-lifecycle.test.ts`, with only minimal harness additions in `test/helpers/recorder-test-harness.ts`.

Red
- Add subprocess/bin tests that currently expose: inherited stdin; large binary payloads independently preserved on stdout/stderr and in semantics; child-created destination collision and symlink; a stage/scratch placement that would be non-ignored or cross-device; real (OS-induced, not injected) raw-cleanup and promotion failures; two-process race/no-overwrite; ordinary cleanup; and child signal combined with Recorder failure yielding one scanned JSON line and 125.
- Expand the packed-install test to invoke the actual generated `.bin` for stdin, nonzero, signal, stream separation, manifest outcome, and Recorder failure. Assert exact code/signal, bytes, one invocation, final destination contents/absence, no leftover transaction paths, and a single parseable sanitized failure line.
- Use filesystem permissions, child-created filesystem objects, and concurrent processes as the failure/race oracles. Do not add production fault switches or mocks. Skip only where an OS capability is genuinely unavailable, with an explicit capability check.

Green
- Allocate the publication stage beneath the archive repository’s already-ignored private `.ak/work` area (or another verified ignored private directory on that same archive filesystem), while raw tee scratch remains outside the worktree or mechanically verified ignored. Verify device identity where needed before spawn/promotion.
- Publish by one same-filesystem atomic rename guarded by a minimal create-if-absent/no-follow reservation or equivalent filesystem primitive; revalidate parent identity at publication, reject collisions/symlinks, never delete/replace an existing destination, and remove any reservation on every path. Do not retain the current check-then-rename marker protocol if it cannot mechanically prevent a destination race.
- Keep `manifest.json` inside the staged tree and expose it only through successful atomic publication. Required raw cleanup occurs before publication; failure cleanup removes stage/reservations best-effort without creating final-looking output. Preserve successful child exit/signal after publication; Recorder failures serialize once and return 125.
- Rebuild checked-in `dist/recorder/*` from the TypeScript owner and run focused transaction/package tests, then full `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, and a clean `npm pack`/installed-tarball acceptance run.

Same-filesystem atomicity
- The stage and final docket parent must be descendants of the same canonical archive worktree and verified on the same filesystem. Raw scratch may be elsewhere because it is deleted before publication; it must be outside the repository or ignored. No cross-device rename fallback, copy-based promotion, parallel transaction implementation, or final-path partial manifest is permitted.

Scope
- Minimal expected production change: transaction/promotion logic in `src/recorder/run.ts` plus generated `dist/recorder/run.js`; launcher only if installed signal evidence finds a real launcher defect. Tests/harness cover the listed black-box matrix.
- Preserve acceptance, scanner, admission, manifest/schema, and role behavior. No production test hooks, relaxed assertions/AC, README/Soul expansion, unrelated repair, or Git changes in plan phase. Apply should use one coherent forward commit unless independent package-launcher and transaction defects are both proven to require separate ownership.
